name: HyprVYZR
author: skll
description: Kasm Workspaces on the desktop: every workspace on your remote Kasm servers, the one on this machine and Kasm's images run natively in Docker, in a carousel like OmaCraft's wallpaper picker. Each session opens in its own popup window that minimises to a folder on the bar. OmaCraft's HyprVYZR page adds servers, installs a local one, sets the key and places the launchers.

barWidget.description: A folder of Kasm workspaces; minimised sessions wait here

schema.label: Workspaces
schema.description: Workspace keys to show (hyprvyzr workspaces lists them); empty shows the first ones.

schema.label: At most
schema.description: How many workspaces the drawer shows when none are pinned.

schema.label: Opens on
schema.description: click: the icon opens and closes it. hover: it opens while the pointer is over it.

schema.label: Opens towards
schema.description: auto: towards the middle of the bar.
